name: invoiceninja
description: Invoice Ninja (MySQL/MariaDB): DB auto-detection dumps the database; public/ and storage/ (uploaded logos, PDFs, backups) live in the stack folder and are included. CRITICAL: the APP_KEY in the .env encrypts fields in the DB - the .env is captured with the stack folder, but keep an offline copy too: a dump restored WITHOUT the matching APP_KEY makes encrypted values (e.g. gateway credentials) unreadable.
